issues.description: The grammar point is 'before and after clauses', but the dialogue and the grammar note only demonstrate 'before'. The note mentions 'after' but gives no example of an after clause, so learners see only half the point in action.
issues.suggested_fix: Add an 'after' example to the grammar note, e.g.: "After I go to the gym, I feel good." Or change a dialogue line to include one, e.g. Ben: 'After I go to the gym, I feel strong.'

qa_report.summary: A clean, accurate micro-dialogue at A2. All three lines are grammatical and natural ('Before I joined the gym, I was tired.', 'How many days a week do you go?', 'Three days. I want a strong body.'), the target word 'gym' is used and glossed simply and correctly, and both review words ('week', 'body') appear naturally. Every word and structure is at or below A2, and the length fits the 10-15 second spec. The only blemish is that the grammar point 'before and after clauses' is illustrated only with 'before'; the note names 'after' but gives no example. This is minor and does not block approval.
